# Localix

> Localix is an open source Agentic Development Environment: a team of AI agents with your
> editor, terminals and browser. Use any model, or run one locally. It is one desktop application made of
> a React workspace, a local Bun/Hono API, and an agent runtime.

## Reaching Localix from a program

Localix serves its own HTTP API locally. It binds 127.0.0.1:5051 by default (HOST, PORT) and mounts
its routes under /rpc/*. CORS headers are returned only to localhost origins.

- GET /health — liveness, plus the running instance id and API protocol version.
- GET /rpc/ws — the multiplexed WebSocket carrying live server-to-client events.
- POST /rpc/webhook/messages — post external text into an existing chat session. No authentication,
  signature check, or replay protection: https://localix.ai/docs/features--webhook
- localix / localix run "<prompt>" / localix open <path> — CLI over the same runtime:
  https://localix.ai/docs/features--cli

There is no OpenAPI or other machine-readable description of these routes; they are documented in
prose and in source: https://localix.ai/docs/internals--architecture

## MCP

Localix is an MCP client. It connects to MCP servers you configure, and /rpc/mcp is the management
API for those records; Localix exposes no MCP server of its own: https://localix.ai/docs/features--mcp

## Getting it

No desktop build is published yet; Localix runs from a source checkout with Bun.
Install: https://localix.ai/docs/getting-started--installation
Docs: https://localix.ai/docs — Source: https://github.com/rsaryev/localix
